job: Start a new screen inside the app shell with a hero, a one-line purpose and an empty content band.
purpose: The smallest app screen: the shell, a page hero with a title and one line, and an empty band that grows. Copy it, rename it, put the content in the band. It has no states of its own: a screen made from it adds its own, and the starting points are fd-states, fd-skeleton and fd-empty.
useWhen: A new screen needs the shell, a hero and a place to build.
A page is being sketched and the content is not decided.

avoidWhen.when: The page needs the shell as server-rendered markup without a script.
The screen is a list, a form or a dashboard that an existing template already shapes.

states.name: default
states.how: none beyond the default: there is no content to load, fail or leave empty
